scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w api --if-present && npm run test -w web --if-present
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w api --if-present && npm run lint -w web --if-present
